answer_1.quote: GR initially emerged with the work of GENRE, in which an encoder-decoder model retrieves a document by generating the title of the document from a given query. [...] Instead of mapping to IDs for document identifiers, other works explore generating content directly from documents as identifiers. For instance, SEAL utilizes spans, and MINDER and LTRGR leverage a combination of titles, pseudo-queries, and spans.
answer_1.outputs: Generated document identifiers (e.g., titles, spans, pseudo-queries) for retrieval.
